scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run build && mkdir -p test-results && vitest list --no-static-parse --json=test-results/vitest-discovery.json && vitest run --coverage --reporter=default --reporter=json --reporter=./scripts/vitest-execution-reporter.ts --outputFile.json=test-results/vitest.json && node scripts/check-test-execution.mjs vitest test-results/vitest-discovery.json test-results/vitest.json
scripts.test:editor:inside: COVERAGE_BROWSER=1 npm run check && COVERAGE_BROWSER=1 vite build --config vite.views.config.ts && sh scripts/run-playwright-quality.sh editor
scripts.build:debug: node scripts/check-assets.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode debug --outDir dist-debug
scripts.build:views: node scripts/check-assets.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vite build --config vite.views.config.ts
scripts.test:browser:inside: COVERAGE_BROWSER=1 npm run check && COVERAGE_BROWSER=1 vite build --mode debug --outDir dist-debug && COVERAGE_BROWSER=1 vite build --config vite.views.config.ts && sh scripts/run-playwright-quality.sh browser
scripts.test:all:inside: COVERAGE_BROWSER=1 npm run check && COVERAGE_BROWSER=1 vite build --mode debug --outDir dist-debug && COVERAGE_BROWSER=1 vite build --config vite.views.config.ts && sh scripts/run-playwright-quality.sh all
